SYMPTOM: `tauri build` on Windows linked FluidAudio FFI symbols (fa_is_available, fa_load_model) even with --no-default-features flag — the flag wasn't passing through npx tauri
CAUSE: fluidaudio was in default features in Cargo.toml; tauri build uses default features; CLI flag passthrough unreliable
FIX:
  1. Removed fluidaudio from `[features] default = []` in Cargo.toml
  2. Updated macOS build/release scripts to pass `-- --features fluidaudio` explicitly to npx tauri build
  3. cargo check on both platforms passes
PREVENT: Any new macOS-only feature must be added to the explicit --features flags in CI/build scripts, NOT to defaults
